title: 第23章 心狠毒辣第24章 战斗突破十步一人
content_zh:
第23章心狠毒辣
“魅影！”
楚风眠心神一动，再次催动魅影身法。
顿时三道身影，同时分化出来，那一道到底是真身，几乎无法判别。
“化身虚影！
这是只有地级身法才能做到的！
这小子修行的是地级身法！
给我抓住他！
抓住他，本少有重赏！”
后面那少堂主，看见楚风眠分化虚影，眼神之中的贪婪更甚，大吼起来。
地级身法，就算是在武胜学院中都未曾出现过的，要是能够得到，依赖这身法，就足以位列武胜国度的巅峰。
“真是难缠。”
楚风眠的心中暗叹一声。
那三道虚影分化出来，九位中年人却是三三一队，几乎没有丝毫迟疑，便是将三道虚影全部追逐到。
这等配合，想要从中逃出，几乎没有任何办法。
现在的楚风眠，已经深陷包围，想要冲出去，几乎没有丝毫可能。
“小子，将你的身法剑术交出来，本少可以饶你一命，这是你最后的机会。”
少堂主在一旁，冷笑连连的看着楚风眠。
“就算你身法在精妙，今日你也逃不出去！”
“交出去？”

楚风眠眼神冰冷。
这可不是将身法剑术交出去就可以了事的，这等身法，剑术，人人都不想让其他人得到，更何况倒时候楚风眠就算不死，也最少会被贬为奴隶关押。
如今既然无法逃，那便是唯有一战，拼死一战。
“杀！”
楚风眠口中冰冷吐出一个字。
他拔剑了，玄青剑在楚风眠的手中，轰然出现，楚风眠身上的灵力，也是膨胀，爆发出来，在身躯中运转。
“哦？还是一把玄级轻剑？”
少堂主眼神露出一丝狠色道。
“杀了这小子，把他杀了，带他是尸体去找父亲，父亲也可以将他抽魂炼魄！”
“是！”
九名中年人同时附和一声，一个个便是对着楚风眠冲了过去。
content_en:
Chapter 23 Cruel and vicious
"Phantom!"
Chu Fengmian's mind moved and he activated the phantom body technique again.
Suddenly three figures differentiated at the same time. It was almost impossible to tell which one was the real body.
"Become a shadow!
This is only possible with earth-level body skills!
This kid practices earth-level body skills!
Catch him!
If you catch him, I will reward you greatly! "
The young hall master behind saw Chu Fengmian's split shadow, the greed in his eyes became even more intense, and he yelled.
Earth-level movement techniques have never appeared even in Wusheng Academy. If you can obtain them and rely on them, you will be able to reach the pinnacle of Wusheng Kingdom.
"It's really difficult."
Chu Fengmian sighed secretly in his heart.
The three phantoms separated, but the nine middle-aged people formed a team of three and three. They chased all three phantoms without any hesitation.
With such cooperation, there is almost no way to escape.
Chu Fengmian was now deeply surrounded, and it was almost impossible to break out.
"Boy, hand over your body and sword skills, and I can spare your life. This is your last chance."
The young hall master stood aside and looked at Chu Fengmian with a sneer.
"Even if your body skills are exquisite, you can't escape today!"
"Hand it over?"
Chu Fengmian's eyes were cold.
This is not something that can be settled by just handing over the body skills and sword skills. No one wants this kind of body skills and sword skills to be obtained by others. What's more, even if Chu Fengmian survives, he will at least be demoted to a slave and imprisoned.
Now that there is no way to escape, the only option is to fight and fight to the death.
"Kill!"
Chu Fengmian spat out one word coldly.
He drew his sword, and the Xuan Qing Sword suddenly appeared in Chu Fengmian's hand. The spiritual power in Chu Fengmian's body also expanded, burst out, and circulated in his body.
"Oh? Or a Xuan-level light sword?"
The young hall master said with a hint of ruthlessness in his eyes.
"Kill this kid, kill him, and take his body to his father. Father can also extract his soul and refine it!"
"Yes!"
Nine middle-aged men echoed at the same time and rushed towards Chu Fengmian one by one.
